result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off — both the image and the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' are truncated, making it unclear what the full name is.
issues.suggestion: Either show only complete cards that fully fit within the viewport, or add a horizontal scroll indicator to clearly signal that the list is scrollable. Ensure the card text truncation uses an ellipsis consistently and that the restaurant name is fully visible on tap.

issues.description: The last category filter pill in the horizontal filter row (after 'Healthy') is partially visible, showing only a sliver of the next option. This may confuse users into thinking the list ends at 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partially visible pill is clearly distinguishable as a scrollable overflow indicator, or add a fade/gradient effect at the edge to hint that more options exist beyond the visible area.
